subject: Commencement: procurement security assertions, DPA, SOC2 & PO path
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Brooks <tanya@clippercloud.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Commencement: procurement security assertions, DPA, SOC2 & PO path

Hi Tanya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Clipper Cloud looks like a solid fit for the vector-store tier. Procurement at Redwood needs a couple of items to move the PO and vendor activation forward. Can you share the following so we can start the intake?

- Signed or signable DPA (we can e-sign via DocuSign). If you prefer, send a redline-friendly PDF.
- SOC 2 report or a URL where our security team can download it (read-only link is fine).
- Current subprocessor registry (csv preferred) including cloud infra providers and CDNs.
- W-9 or taxpayer form for US invoicing (if available).
- Preferred billing contact and invoice remit email.

I attached our standard Procurement Intake Form — please complete the top section and return it with the items above. Once we have those, Naomi (cc'd) will generate a PO# and route a standard Redwood PO to your billing contact. Typical turnaround on our side is 3–5 business days after we receive completed docs.

A couple of quick clarifications we need: does your subprocessor list include the public cloud provider (e.g., AWS account details or region)? Also confirm whether you will accept our standard PO terms (we can loop legal if not).

If easier, legal@clippercloud.com can be included on responses for the DPA execution.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Vendor Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Procurement_Intake_Form_ClipperCloud.pdf
From: Tanya Brooks <tanya@clippercloud.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clipper Cloud Legal <legal@clippercloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commencement: procurement security assertions, DPA, SOC2 & PO path

Lukas,

Great to hear — happy to move this forward. See answers below and attached files.

- SOC 2: public link to our most recent report: https://clippercloud.com/security/soc2-report-2025.pdf (we provide a download token to customers; included in attachments as SOC2-Link.txt).
- Subprocessors: attached CSV (subprocessors-clipper_v1.csv). It includes AWS (us-west-2), FastCDN, and a managed vector indexer partner.
- DPA: I’ve uploaded our standard DPA to DocuSign and sent to legal@clippercloud.com for signature; I can also add your team as recipients if you want the signed copy routed back to you automatically. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/CLIPPER/DPA-12345
- W-9: attached (ClipperCloud_W9.pdf) — please confirm secure receipt.
- Billing contact: finance@clippercloud.com (Attn: Priya Rao). Please route PO and remit instructions there.

We can accept standard Redwood POs but will need a certificate of insurance (COI) to be attached to the vendor file before we mark the account active. If you can point Naomi to a short form for COI upload, we’ll add it to the intake record.

Estimated internal readiness: once DPA is signed and PO dispatched, we can provision test keys within 48 hours; production keys after payment terms are agreed.

Thanks,
Tanya Brooks
Head of Partnerships
Clipper Cloud

Attachments: subprocessors-clipper_v1.csv, ClipperCloud_W9.pdf, SOC2-Link.txt
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Brooks <tanya@clippercloud.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commencement: procurement security assertions, DPA, SOC2 & PO path

Thanks Tanya — this is perfect and fast. A couple follow-ups inline: 

> - Subprocessors: attached CSV (subprocessors-clipper_v1.csv). It includes AWS (us-west-2), FastCDN, and a managed vector indexer partner.

Can you confirm whether the managed vector indexer partner processes customer-unencrypted payloads or only metadata (we need this for our privacy mapping)?

> - DPA: I’ve uploaded our standard DPA to DocuSign and sent to legal@clippercloud.com for signature; I can also add your team as recipients if you want the signed copy routed back to you automatically. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/CLIPPER/DPA-12345

Please add naomi.feldman@redwood.ai and legal@redwood.ai to the DocuSign envelope so we get the executed PDF automatically. If you prefer, we can accept the signed PDF via secure SFTP — whichever is easiest for your legal ops.

Naomi — when you kick the PO, could you confirm the exact header we should include so Clipper can ingest it into their vendor portal? Also we will attach the COI once procurement uploads it.

Ben — FYI on timelines: Tanya indicates test keys in 48 hours after DPA + PO. I’ll coordinate a short smoke test with you once we have the keys.

Thanks all,
Lukas
From: Tanya Brooks <tanya@clippercloud.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clipper Cloud Legal <legal@clippercloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commencement: procurement security assertions, DPA, SOC2 & PO path

Lukas / Naomi / Ben,

Confirming items completed on our side: 

- DPA: executed and the signed PDF is attached to the DocuSign envelope. I added naomi.feldman@redwood.ai and legal@redwood.ai as recipients; you should receive the executed copy via email and a download from the link.
- Subprocessor question: the vector indexer partner processes tokenized vectors — no customer PII is stored in plaintext; they process hashed identifiers and encrypted payloads per our contract. I’ve flagged the indexer vendor row in the attached CSV.
- Billing: finance@clippercloud.com will accept PO RL- format (PO number in subj + vendor portal entry). Their remit address and tax ID are on the W-9.
- COI: we need a COI with Redwood listed as an additional insured; upload to the vendor portal or email to vendorops@clippercloud.com.

We’ll provision test keys within 48 hours of your PO being visible in our portal and confirm a target production enablement timeline once payment terms are confirmed.

Link to executed DPA: https://app.docusign.com/CLIPPER/DPA-12345

Best,
Tanya Brooks
Head of Partnerships
Clipper Cloud

Attachments: ClipperCloud_DPA_Signed.pdf
